nodes.name: gui_runner.py
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the virtuoso-gui-debug skill. Parses arguments, validates scenarios, dispatches FakeExecutor / LiveExecutor / LocalExecutor, and emits exactly one compact JSON object per invocation (with structured exit codes 0/1/2).
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 script using pathlib-based sys.path manipulation to load the sibling vgui_runner package; strict exit-code contract and single-line JSON stdout pattern.

nodes.name: command_runner.py
nodes.summary: Fixed-argv subprocess transport for the live executor. Defines CommandError, CommandResult, CommandRunner base class, plus LocalRunner (subprocess.run with cleaned env) and SshRunner (safe shlex.quote of a fixed vcli argv). Rejects shell strings, NUL, newlines, and any remote argv injection.
nodes.languageNotes: Python with frozen dataclass for CommandResult; enforces a strict environment allowlist (PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, VB_PORT, VB_REMOTE_HOST) plus VCLI_CAPABILITY=admin.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: State machine and step runner for scenario execution. Defines RunState / StepPhase / StepOutcome enums, the Executor ABC, FakeExecutor (deterministic offline outcomes keyed by step/phase/attempt), and the Runner that drives precheck → baseline → execute → verify → recover with retries and JSONL tracing.
nodes.languageNotes: Python ABC protocol with Runner class owning retry/rollback semantics; uses frozen tuples for step outputs and dataclass RunSummary for results.

nodes.name: live_executor.py
nodes.summary: Real vcli/SSH/X11 executor implementing the Executor protocol against an injected command runner. Binds session/PID/DISPLAY/window at precheck, holds a per-DISPLAY flock, dispatches GUI actions via fixed `vcli window action-x11` argv, sanitizes typed input out of errors, and supports a fast --direct path plus action-x11-batch.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest module in the package (~1026 lines); uses fcntl.flock, MappingProxyType, regex-based argv templating, and a dedicated _DisplayLock context manager.

nodes.name: local_executor.py
nodes.summary: Direct xdotool executor for scenarios whose DISPLAY is local to the runner. Implements the Executor protocol via xdotool (search/getwindowgeometry/click/type/key) and ImageMagick import for screenshots. Supports SCROLL (xdotool buttons 4/5/6/7) and binds target window by PID at precheck.
nodes.languageNotes: Python class with private helpers (_xdotool, _window_geometry, _absolute_coords) translating relative coords to absolute via xdotool geometry output.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Strict scenario parser producing deeply immutable dataclasses (Scenario, Step, CellView) with the Operation enum, per-operation argument schemas, integer/string/predicate allowlists, and ScenarioValidationError on any deviation. Supports version 1.0 round-trip via MappingProxyType.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses MappingProxyType / tuple / frozenset for deep immutability; central OP_ARG_SCHEMAS, INT_ARG_KEYS, STR_ARG_KEYS, BUTTON_ARG_KEYS, WINDOW_WAIT_ALLOWED_STATES, SCROLL_ALLOWED_DIRECTIONS tables.

nodes.name: trace.py
nodes.summary: Append-only JSONL event log with immediate flush. Provides Event dataclass and Trace class emitting monotonic sequence-numbered, UTC-timestamped state/step/attempt/outcome/duration/details records.
nodes.languageNotes: Tiny module: Event dataclass + Trace class with lazy file open and explicit close().

nodes.name: test_command_runner.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for command_runner covering the 2026-09-01 live-executor security contract: local subprocess uses shell=False, environment is cleaned to the allowlist, VCLI_CAPABILITY=admin is set, timeouts yield structured CommandResult, SSH mode accepts only safe hosts and a fixed vcli argv, and NUL/newline/extra-remote-command argv is rejected.
nodes.languageNotes: unittest-based; uses a RecordingRunner fake rather than mocking subprocess directly; macOS-tolerant (filters __CF_* and LC_CTYPE leaked env vars).

nodes.name: test_engine.py
nodes.summary: Tests for engine state machine and FakeExecutor: per-phase success/failure, attempt-based retries, recover/rollback paths, atomic task.json output, and trace event sequence. Validates happy-path, precheck/baseline failures, recover-then-retry, no-retry-when-max_retries=0, and final FAILED event payload.
nodes.languageNotes: unittest; uses tempfile.mkdtemp for per-test output dirs and an outcomes_to_dict helper to build FakeExecutor scenarios.

nodes.name: test_live_executor.py
nodes.summary: Largest test module: covers LiveExecutor precheck (session/port/PID/DISPLAY/window/lock), baseline screenshot sanitization, every DSL operation mapping to a fixed vcli argv, verify predicates (database-first), recover rollbacks, typed-input sanitization, _DisplayLock lifecycle, and argv-level session awareness.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a scripted FakeRunner (per-test list of CommandResult/Exception/callable) so no ssh/vcli/X11 is ever invoked; sessions_json and WINDOWS_ONE constants build realistic vcli responses.

nodes.name: test_local_executor.py
nodes.summary: Tests for LocalExecutor (xdotool path) with subprocess.run mocked: precheck (xdotool missing, DISPLAY unreachable, no-window-for-pid, window found, explicit --window-id), execute for every supported operation incl. SCROLL, verify predicates, recover rollback, baseline screenshot, and geometry-guard against missing X server.
nodes.languageNotes: unittest.mock with @mock.patch on shutil.which and _run; constructs mock.Mock completed-process objects to avoid any real subprocess execution.

nodes.name: test_model.py
nodes.summary: Strict scenario-parsing tests for model.py: version 1.0, Operation enum, CellView, root type checks, duplicate step IDs, missing/invalid verifiers, session_id / PID / display rules, timeout/retry bounds, per-operation argument-type validation (40+ operations), verifier predicates, rollback shape, deep immutability, and JSON round-trip.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest single test file in the skill (~875 lines, 29 TestCase classes); uses VALID_SCENARIO dict constant and Scenario.from_dict everywhere; covers negative paths exhaustively.

nodes.name: parse_fake_outcomes
nodes.summary: Reads a fake-outcomes JSON file (list of {step_id, phase, attempt, outcome} dicts), validates each field, and returns {(step_id, phase, attempt): StepOutcome} for FakeExecutor.
nodes.languageNotes: Strict phase allowlist (precheck/baseline/execute/verify/recover) and outcome allowlist (SUCCESS/FAILURE); raises ValueError on first violation.

nodes.name: cmd_validate
nodes.summary: Loads a scenario via Scenario.load and emits either a valid-summary JSON or a structured invalid/error JSON. Returns exit 0 on success, 2 on validation or unexpected error.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps Scenario.load with two distinct except branches: ScenarioValidationError vs generic Exception.

nodes.name: build_executor
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a (executor, error) tuple for the --executor choice: fake (with optional outcomes file), live (needs session_id + vcli_path + ssh_host), local (needs display + pid). Errors are returned as dicts, not raised, so the CLI can JSON-emit them.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazy imports inside the function for LiveExecutor / LocalExecutor to keep the offline fake path import-light.

nodes.name: cmd_run
nodes.summary: Top-level run handler: builds the executor, loads the scenario, runs Runner.run, emits the final RunSummary JSON, and returns 0/1/2 based on passed/failed/error.
nodes.languageNotes: Reuses build_executor for the (executor, error) tuple and traps broad exceptions to emit a structured error payload.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: argparse entry point: dispatches `validate` and `run` subcommands, builds the executor, ensures output_dir exists, and propagates the exit code.
nodes.languageNotes: Two subcommands (validate, run); never prints human text — all diagnostics go to stderr only.

nodes.name: CommandRunner
nodes.summary: Abstract base for LocalRunner / SshRunner: validates argv (no shell strings, no NUL/newline), then delegates to subclass _run_validated with a timeout.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure template-method: public run() does validation, abstract _run_validated does the actual execution.

nodes.name: LocalRunner
nodes.summary: Runs the fixed argv locally via subprocess.run with shell=False, cleaned environment, universal_newlines, and a hard timeout that surfaces as CommandResult(timed_out=True).
nodes.languageNotes: Tracks duration_ms via time.monotonic; on TimeoutExpired returns (None, '', str(exc), duration_ms, True).

nodes.name: SshRunner
nodes.summary: Runs vcli over SSH using a fixed remote argv constructed by shell-quoting each element with shlex.quote. Validates ssh_host against a strict regex, rejects extra remote commands, returns CommandResult with timed_out/exit_code/duration_ms.
nodes.languageNotes: Performs a structured ConnectError catch (ssh exit 255) separate from generic subprocess errors; refuses any argv whose first element is not the configured vcli_path.

nodes.name: Executor
nodes.summary: Abstract Executor protocol: precheck, baseline, execute, verify, recover — each returns Optional[Dict[str, Any]] where None means OK.
nodes.languageNotes: Five @abstractmethod decorators; no concrete behavior.

nodes.name: FakeExecutor
nodes.summary: Deterministic offline executor: looks up outcomes by (step_id, phase, attempt) and returns {'error': '...'} when the entry is FAILURE, None otherwise. Default outcome is SUCCESS.
nodes.languageNotes: Used by tests and by `gui_runner --executor fake`; no I/O whatsoever.

nodes.name: Runner
nodes.summary: Drives a Scenario through PRECHECK → BASELINE per-step EXECUTE/VERIFY with retries → RECOVER with rollback → PASSED/FAILED. Emits JSONL trace events, writes atomic task.json, and returns a RunSummary.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest class in engine.py (~207 lines); tracks current_state, failed_step_id, error_code, and step_attempts.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: Immutable step record with id, operation, MappingProxyType arguments/verifier, timeout_seconds, max_retries, and optional rollback. Validates types against OP_ARG_SCHEMAS at construction.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclass wrapped in MappingProxyType; construction is the single validation chokepoint.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Top-level immutable scenario container: version, task_id, session_id, pid, display, CellView, and ordered tuple of Steps. Validates the whole tree, rejects duplicate step IDs and unknown fields, and round-trips through to_dict/from_dict.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest class in model.py; raises ScenarioValidationError(path=...) on any rule violation; CellView is a small companion frozen dataclass.

nodes.name: _DisplayLock
nodes.summary: Per-DISPLAY exclusive flock under ~/.cache/virtuoso_bridge/x11-locks/. Acquired with LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB; raises LockHeldError if another run holds it; records the holder's PID in the lock file.
nodes.languageNotes: Context-manager protocol (`__enter__`/`__exit__`); one lock per DISPLAY string, sanitized via regex.

nodes.name: LiveExecutor
nodes.summary: Real vcli/X11 executor (898 lines, ~25 methods). Implements all five phases by translating DSL operations into fixed `vcli` argv calls through the injected command runner. Manages session binding, lock lifecycle, direct vs helper path, action-x11 batching, and typed-input sanitization in all error paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Heaviest module in the package; uses MappingProxyType for argv construction, regex for argv templating, fcntl for the display lock, and structured error dicts throughout.

nodes.name: LocalExecutor
nodes.summary: xdotool-based executor for local DISPLAY targets. Binds the window by PID at precheck, dispatches click/type/key/scroll/screenshot directly via xdotool and ImageMagick import, supports geometry-aware relative→absolute coord conversion, and rejects VCLI_LOAD/VCLI_CALL (use LiveExecutor for those).
nodes.languageNotes: ~406 lines, ~14 methods; uses subprocess.run through a private _run wrapper; private helpers _xdotool, _window_geometry, _absolute_coords, _screenshot.

nodes.name: Trace
nodes.summary: Append-only JSONL writer that opens lazily, flushes after every emit(), increments a monotonic seq counter, and stamps each Event with UTC ISO-8601 ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazy file open in _open(); explicit close() resets _file so a Trace can be reused.

nodes.name: TestLocalRunner
nodes.summary: Covers LocalRunner: argv-list form, env cleaning, VCLI_CAPABILITY=admin, timeout → timed_out, non-zero exit reporting, string-argv rejection, empty-argv rejection, and argv-element NUL/newline rejection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses sys.executable as the test binary so the suite runs on any host; tolerates macOS __CF_* / LC_CTYPE leak.

nodes.name: TestSshRunnerValidation
nodes.summary: Covers SshRunner argv safety: host regex enforcement, vcli-path requirement, NUL/newline rejection, shlex.quote correctness, and rejection of any argv element that isn't the configured vcli binary.
nodes.languageNotes: 10 test methods; focused entirely on construction-time rejection paths.

nodes.name: TestFakeExecutorPerPhase
nodes.summary: Validates FakeExecutor behavior across all five phases: default SUCCESS, per-attempt outcomes, execute failure at attempt 0 / success at attempt 1, verify and recover failure paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses outcomes_to_dict helper to build the (step, phase, attempt) → outcome map.

nodes.name: TestRunnerHappyPath
nodes.summary: Happy-path Runner tests: both steps pass → RunSummary(passed=True), atomic task.json contains expected summary fields, output directory is created, trace has correct event sequence.
nodes.languageNotes: Warnings.simplefilter('error') to catch any DeprecationWarning leaked from the Runner.

nodes.name: TestExecuteFailRecoverSuccess
nodes.summary: Verifies that when execute fails, recover is invoked and the step can move on, producing a passing summary and a recover trace event.
nodes.languageNotes: Two test methods covering recover-success and recover-failure-then-final-failed.

nodes.name: TestPrecheck
nodes.summary: Largest test class (145 lines, 13 methods) covering LiveExecutor.precheck: missing session, port mismatch, PID zero / fallback, DISPLAY mismatch, zero/multiple windows, lock conflict, and the pid-fallback path.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds scripted FakeRunner responses that mimic real vcli JSON for sessions list, windows list, and dismiss-dialog.

nodes.name: TestExecuteMapping
nodes.summary: Maps every supported DSL operation (WINDOW_ACTIVATE, KEY, TYPE, CLICK_REL/ABS, DOUBLE_CLICK, DRAG_REL, SCROLL, MINIMIZE, MAXIMIZE, CLOSE, DISMISS_DIALOG) onto the exact `vcli window action-x11` argv the live executor must produce.
nodes.languageNotes: 10 test methods; asserts exact argv lists against expected_vcli_argv snapshots.

nodes.name: TestRecover
nodes.summary: Covers recover-phase dispatch: every rollback shape maps to a fixed vcli argv, only validated rollback operations are accepted, and rollback failure is reported with a structured error.
nodes.languageNotes: 4 test methods; cross-checks LiveExecutor.recover output against expected argv + RunSummary.

nodes.name: TestNewOperationsLive
nodes.summary: Live-executor coverage for newer DSL operations (drag-rel sequence, scroll, window-id disambiguation, session-aware argv). Confirms vcli receives the exact argv the design specifies.
nodes.languageNotes: 8 methods; uses scripted FakeRunner to capture argv and inspect argv content.

nodes.name: TestWindowIdDisambiguation
nodes.summary: Ensures LiveExecutor picks the correct window when multiple are returned (title/class/geometry filters) and forwards --window-id to every vcli call.
nodes.languageNotes: 3 methods; constructs multi-window WINDOWS_* fixtures with different pid/title/geometry.

nodes.name: TestNewVerifierPredicatesLive
nodes.summary: Live-executor verifier coverage for state_matches, title_matches, geometry_matches, ciw_eval — every predicate routes to a specific vcli query and returns the expected bool.
nodes.languageNotes: 5 methods; depends on scripted vcli responses for ciw_eval and geometry.

nodes.name: TestDynamicCiwCoordinates
nodes.summary: Covers dynamic CIW coordinate fetching at execute time: LiveExecutor queries window geometry via vcli, converts relative CLICK_REL coords to absolute, and forwards them to action-x11.
nodes.languageNotes: 4 methods; uses scripted geometry responses to drive the conversion.

nodes.name: TestLocalExecutorPrecheck
nodes.summary: LocalExecutor precheck tests: xdotool missing, DISPLAY unreachable, no-window-for-pid, window-found, explicit --window-id override skipping discovery.
nodes.languageNotes: 6 methods; heavily uses @mock.patch on shutil.which and _run.

nodes.name: TestLocalExecutorExecute
nodes.summary: LocalExecutor execute coverage: every supported operation maps to the correct xdotool command (windowactivate, key, type, click, double-click, drag, scroll, minimize/maximize, screenshot, dismiss-dialog, close). VCLI_LOAD and VCLI_CALL are rejected as fail-closed.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest class in test_local_executor (96 lines, 11 methods); asserts exact xdotool argv.

nodes.name: TestLocalExecutorVerify
nodes.summary: LocalExecutor verify-predicate tests: window_exists, state_matches, title_matches, geometry_matches; each routes through xdotool search/getactivewindow/getwindowname/getwindowgeometry.
nodes.languageNotes: 5 methods; mocks subprocess.run for every xdotool subcommand.

nodes.name: TestLocalExecutorRecover
nodes.summary: LocalExecutor recover coverage: every rollback shape (close, activate, key, type) runs the correct xdotool command; unsupported rollbacks fail closed with a structured error.
nodes.languageNotes: 5 methods; uses mocked xdotool responses and asserts recovered state.

nodes.name: TestLocalExecutorGeometryGuard
nodes.summary: Guards against GeometryError when the bound window disappears mid-run (e.g. xdotool search returns empty, geometry query fails). Verifies local executor reports the error and stops cleanly.
nodes.languageNotes: 7 methods; uses side_effect lists to drive multiple subprocess.run calls per test.

nodes.name: TestOperationArgumentTypes
nodes.summary: Largest test class in test_model (140 lines, 20 methods): exhaustive per-operation argument-type validation — strict int (no bool), positive integer bounds, allowed state strings, allowed scroll directions, allowed predicate names, optional vs required keys, and rejection of unknown keys.
nodes.languageNotes: Parameterized-style test methods, one per Operation key, asserting ScenarioValidationError.path.

nodes.name: TestVerifierValidation
nodes.summary: Covers every supported verifier predicate (window_exists, state_matches, title_matches, geometry_matches, ciw_eval): required keys, expected-type matching, and rejection of unknown predicates at parse time.
nodes.languageNotes: 10 methods; uses a parametrized helper to assert error paths.

nodes.name: TestRollbackValidation
nodes.summary: Validates rollback shapes: only already-validated operations are accepted, required keys are enforced, and unsupported rollback ops fail at parse time.
nodes.languageNotes: 8 methods; cross-checks accepted/rejected rollback ops against the model allowlist.

nodes.name: TestDeepImmutability
nodes.summary: Asserts that Scenario / Step / CellView / arguments / verifier are all deeply frozen (MappingProxyType, tuple, frozenset) — mutations at any level raise TypeError.
nodes.languageNotes: 6 methods; probes attributes, mapping methods, and nested dict values.

nodes.name: TestNewOperations
nodes.summary: Model-level acceptance for newer operations (DRAG_REL with x1/y1/x2/y2, SCROLL with direction+count, CIW_INPUT, VERIFY/RECOVER, NEW_OPERATION additions): valid scenarios parse and reject only on truly unknown operations.
nodes.languageNotes: 9 methods; minimal happy-path tests for the new operation set.

nodes.name: TestOperationArguments
nodes.summary: Confirms OP_ARG_SCHEMAS enforcement: required keys must be present, unknown keys are rejected, and the optional/required split is honored for each operation.
nodes.languageNotes: 4 methods; uses per-operation dicts to construct minimal valid steps.

nodes.name: TestNewVerifierPredicates
nodes.summary: Model-level coverage for the newer verifier predicates (state_matches, title_matches, geometry_matches, ciw_eval): valid expected types per predicate and rejection of malformed expected values.
nodes.languageNotes: 5 methods; small focused validator tests.
